findings.evidence: All hours: 37 'silent' cancels. 18 were followed by the push within 30 min, 11 of them on bridges that had been docked (the other 7 never docked and docked only after the cancel): UAL1986 E5 16 s after the re-dock, UAL901 G4 18 s, ASA1330 B6 84 s, UAL1046 E4 131 s (lag.gnd_30m 539 -> 776 frames), UAL1375 D7 134 s, UAL1498 B4 182 s ... Retraction lead before the push for the 88 bridges retracted early: p50 154 s, p90 770 s; 15 more than 10 min early (max 27 min). [obs lead times; inf: real bridges are pulled a few minutes before the push]
findings.fix: Cancel only when the aircraft has been silent at the stand for a long time (e.g. more than 10 min, matching XPDR_OFF_MS). Do not block a new signal after a 'silent' cancel. Consider delaying the retraction start toward the measured lead distribution.
